text:
lee: Quick questionveryone: My spouse added me to their employer plan as secondary last month. I just got an EOB where Anthem paid only part and the provider says they need the secondary EOB before adjusting the remaining balance. How do I get the secondary to process?
maya (People Ops): Congrats on getting dual coverage. Short version: secondary insurer needs the primary insurer's EOB to coordinate benefits. Two options: 1) Upload the primary EOB to the secondary's member portal under 'Submit EOB for Coordination of Benefits' OR 2) Ask Anthem (primary) to send an EOB to the secondary payer (sometimes called an EOB-to-payer send).
lee: Do I need to change anything in our Benefits Portal for COB?
benefits-bot: Reminder: Add secondary plan details under Benefits Portal -> My Coverage -> Add Other Coverage. Include insurer name, member ID, and policy effective date. This helps us auto-fill COB forms for you.
sam (spouse): I can forward my employer's benefits portal link. My HR team said they accept PDFs of primary EOB + claim info.
maya (People Ops): If the secondary portal only wants a scanned EOB, that works. If they ask for a 'claim payment summary' from Anthem, request a formal EOB PDF from Anthem member services. Anthem can often reissue an EOB or send an EOB-to-payer if you DM them claim info.
lee: What's the minimal message to paste into the secondary portal so it doesn't get tossed? Their upload comment field is tiny.
maya (People Ops): Paste this short cover line: "Please process as secondary under Coordination of Benefits. Primary payer: Anthem (Member ID: <ANTHEM_ID>). Claim #: <CLAIM#>. Date of service: <MM/DD/YYYY>. Primary EOB attached. Please apply payment/adjustment and notify member for any remaining balance. Member phone: <XXX-XXX-XXXX>."
billing-agent: Also include provider NPI and the amount paid by primary. Secondary payers often need exact paid amount and adjustment reason code.
anthem-support: Hi Lee  we can reissue the EOB or send it to the secondary payer. DM us the claim number, member ID, and the secondary insurer's address or payer ID and we'll process an EOB-to-payer request. Typical send time 3-7 business days.
lee: If Anthem refuses to send EOB to secondary, can I just upload a screenshot of the portal?
maya (People Ops): Screenshots sometimes get accepted but a PDF EOB is preferred. If you must use a screenshot, include a brief note and your contact info. Also check whether the provider requires a formal secondary remittance advice (RA) for their billing system.
sam (spouse): My HR said we had to submit COB within 60 days to be eligible for secondary coverage on that date. Is that true?
maya (People Ops): Timeframes vary. Best to add the secondary coverage in our Benefits Portal ASAP and start the EOB submission. If you hit a deadline, ping People Ops and we can help escalate with Anthem or the secondary payer.
lee: Thanks all. @anthem-support I'll DM claim + member ID and @sam I'll upload my EOB to your HR portal once I get the PDF. Appreciate the quick help. :thumbsup:
